ALGER — L’opérateur Ooredoo Algérie anno: ALGIERS — The operator Ooredoo Algeria announces the rollout of the "Gold PROMO" offer, a commercial initiative aimed at expanding access to the internet and communications for its subscribers. This promotional plan applies to the three tiers of the Gold range: Gold 2000, Gold 2500, and Gold 4000. Each customer now benefits from an additional 20 GB of mobile data per month, with no change in pricing.
Le forfait Gold 2000 se distingue par un: The Gold 2000 plan stands out with a major upgrade: the former call credit of 6,000 dinars is replaced by unlimited calls to all national networks. This measure aims to simplify customers' daily usage, particularly for professional or personal communications.

The "Gold PROMO" plan aligns with these requirements, offering tailored solutions without any cost increase.
